messages.subject: Convergence problems
parts:
Hello people,

I'm convergence problems to fit a model.

See the code of the adjustment function:

Ajuste <- function(formula, data){
  fit.sp <- inla(formula=formula, data=data, Ntrials =1, family="binomial", 
  control.inla = list(strategy = "laplace", int.strategy = "grid", fast=FALSE),
  control.family = list(control.link = list(model = "sn",
  hyper = list(alpha = list(prior = "normal",initial = 0, 
  param = c(mean=0.0,prec=0.0004),fixed=FALSE)))),
  control.compute = list(dic=TRUE, waic=T),
  control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE))
  summary(fit.sp)
  return(fit.sp)}


The return of this code is:

GMRFLib version 3.0-0-snapshot, has recived error no [12]
Reason    : The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge
Message   : Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE
Function  : GMRFLib_init_GMRF_approximation_store__intern
File      : approx-inference.c
Line      : 2946
RCSId     : file: approx-inference.c  hgid: 8b30e851fed2  date: Tue Mar 17 10:38:12 2020 +0300

sh: line 1: 2891300 Aborted                 '/cephfs/scratch/7107227/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.6/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.run' -b -s -v -t 20 '/tmp/RtmpbMVQeV/file2c1cc7c327273/Model.ini' > '/tmp/RtmpbMVQeV/file2c1cc7c327273/Logfile.txt'
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.
Calls: Ajuste -> inla -> inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed
In addition: Warning message:
In inla.model.properties.generic(inla.trim.family(model), mm[names(mm) ==  :
  Model 'sn' in section 'link' is marked as 'experimental'; changes may appear at any time.
  Use this model with extra care!!! Further warnings are disabled.
Execution halted
 


do you have any idea how to solve this problem?


Thanks!
